name: Cyrus worker
description: Makes an arbitrary image able to host a Cyrus agent: a private Node runtime, the cyrus-ai worker, the non-root agent user, the workspace and repository-cache paths, the git/gh/curl/jq tools the boot sequence shells out to, and the socat/bubblewrap prerequisites of subprocess env scrubbing.

tarball.description: URL of a gzipped tar of a 'pnpm deploy --prod --legacy' tree built from this repository, extracted as-is. This is the primary mechanism: the cyrus-ai package on public npm is a different, older CLI with no container-boot command. Takes precedence over 'version'.

version.description: npm version range of cyrus-ai, used only when 'tarball' is empty. Valid only where the resolved registry publishes THIS worker; the install asserts container-boot exists and fails the build if it does not.

nodeVersion.description: Exact Node version the worker runs on. Installed privately and deliberately kept OFF PATH so it cannot shadow whatever Node the repository's own toolchain provides.

username.description: Non-root user the worker runs as. Created if absent; reused if the base image already defines it.

uid.description: uid for the worker user when this feature creates it. Ignored if the user already exists.

gid.description: gid for the worker group when this feature creates it. Ignored if the group already exists.

workspacesDir.description: Must match CYRUS_WORKSPACES_DIR. Created and chowned to the worker user.

repoCacheDir.description: Must match CYRUS_REPO_CACHE_DIR. Created and chowned to the worker user.

ghVersion.description: GitHub CLI version. Installed from the checksum-verified release tarball rather than a distro package, because no single package source covers every base family.
